translations.web: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought Yahweh of Armies.
translations.bsb: But the people did not return to Him who struck them; they did not seek the LORD of Hosts.
translations.kjv: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the LORD of hosts.
translations.asv: Yet the people have not turned unto him that smote them, neither have they sought Jehovah of hosts.
